Vendored frontend dependencies (downloaded from their published npm packages).
HeroUI styles 3.2.6: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@heroui/styles
  Official framework-agnostic prebuilt CSS; license in heroui/LICENSE.
Bootstrap 5.2.3: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap, MIT.
Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3: https://github.com/twbs/icons, MIT.
SweetAlert2 11.7.32: https://github.com/sweetalert2/sweetalert2, MIT.
Chart.js 4.4.8: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js, MIT.

HeroUI is loaded before Bootstrap. app.css bridges the existing Django templates
and Bootstrap behavior to HeroUI theme tokens. Component styles live in ../styles/
and load after app.css in base.html. New controls use HeroUI BEM classes.
No React runtime or frontend build step is required.

jQuery 3.7.1: https://github.com/jquery/jquery, MIT (jquery-LICENSE).

controls.js progressively enhances native selects and search inputs with HeroUI
Select/ListBox/SearchField markup. Native fields retain their names and form data;
keyboard, reset, validation and dynamic option behavior are implemented locally.
components.js applies Button styles to static and dynamically inserted actions.
